title: The fine-tune that trained on the wrong data
blurb: Caller-supplied data files and blind restarts discarded progress.
prompt: A fine-tune trained on an unregistered export, and the same job restarted three times from scratch after missed heartbeats, burning a week of GPU budget. The model-generated draft accepts raw data references and restarts silent trainers blind. Review it, fix it, and prove data is versioned and restarts resume.
aiNote: The draft accepts a caller-supplied dataset file, bypassing registry provenance entirely, and restarts a trainer on a missed heartbeat from scratch rather than requesting a checkpoint, so transient unresponsiveness silently multiplies compute cost.
testIdea: Submit a raw file reference and assert 400; simulate a missed heartbeat and assert a checkpoint request precedes any restart; finish a job with a failing eval and assert it reports not promotable.
followUps: What hyperparameters must stay fixed for reproducibility?
How do you price a job's budget before it runs?
What belongs in a job's lineage so a result can be reproduced a year later?
